name: mobileproxy
description: Control dedicated 4G mobile and residential proxies on mobileproxy.space: rotate IPs, change geo, check balance, buy.
long_description: Gives Claude direct control over your mobileproxy.space account. Each mobile proxy is a dedicated 4G/LTE modem with a real carrier IP, so one account keeps one stable IP for as long as you need: multi-account management, anti-detect browser profiles, ad verification. Rotate the IP on demand, move a proxy to another country or operator without re-buying, and manage traffic-billed residential packages. Purchases always show the price first and need your confirmation.
